content.text:
**答案：Leonardo de Moura（莱昂纳多·德·莫拉）。** 2013 年他在微软研究院发起 Lean 项目。后来他和 Sebastian Ullrich 一起创办了 Lean FRO，现在在 AWS 工作。

依据（共搜了 1 次）：
- https://sloan.org/grant-detail/g-2023-19661 ：原文是 "Launched by Leonardo de Moura when he was working at Microsoft Research in 2013"
- https://lean-lang.org/fro/about/ ：原文是 "De Moura created Lean in 2013 and previously worked … at Microsoft Research"
- https://graphsearch.epfl.ch/en/concept/62889984 ：Lean 词条里写着 "launched by Leonardo de Moura at Microsoft Research in 2013"
